class.name: BindingEngine
class.brief_description: Static utility for MVVM data and command bindings.
class.description:
BindingEngine establishes one-way data bindings (ViewModel property → target node property) and command bindings (node signal → ViewModel method). All methods are static.
Two usage patterns: - [b]Explicit API[/b] (recommended): call [method bind_property] / [method bind_command] directly. - [b]Batch sugar[/b]: call [method bind] with a view node that has [code]"bindings"[/code] / [code]"commands"[/code] metadata.
Property bindings address targets by [ObjectID], so once the target node is freed the update becomes a no-op (no dangling access). Command connections are torn down automatically when the source node is freed.
You can call BindingEngine directly, or use the equivalent static methods on [Context] ([method Context.bind], [method Context.bind_property], [method Context.bind_command]).

method.name: bind
method.description: Scans [param view] node and all descendants for metadata keys [code]"bindings"[/code] and [code]"commands"[/code], then calls [method bind_property] / [method bind_command] accordingly.

method.name: bind_command
method.description: Connects [param signal] on [param source] to call [param method] on [param vm]. Example: [code]BindingEngine.bind_command($Button, "pressed", vm, "on_go")[/code].

method.name: bind_property
method.description: Binds [param source_property] on [param vm] to [param target_property] on [param target]. Whenever the ViewModel property changes, the target property is updated automatically. Example: [code]BindingEngine.bind_property($Label, "text", vm, "title")[/code].
